description: Behavioural evaluation set for the notion skill. Cases pin the routing decision (MCP default vs `ntn` CLI exceptions), the pre-flight discipline (Markdown spec + schema fetch before content writes), the skip/refuse path (different knowledge tool), and the empirical gotchas (batching, repositioning).

evals.name: mcp-default-create-database
evals.prompt: Create a Notion database called 'Demo Tasks' inside our Engineering page with a Title column and a Status select (Todo / Doing / Done).
evals.expected_output: Skill triggers, runs the pre-flight (reads the `notion://docs/enhanced-markdown-spec` MCP resource, then `notion-fetch`es the parent Engineering page to anchor the new database), and calls `notion-create-database` with the SQL DDL DSL — not the `ntn` CLI. Confirms the database lands at the bottom of the parent page (gotcha #2) and offers to reposition via the two-op `notion-update-page update_content` pattern if the user wants it elsewhere.

evals.name: cli-required-file-upload
evals.prompt: Upload screenshot.png from my desktop to the Notion page about Q4 mockups.
evals.expected_output: Inspects the active Notion connector for upload support. Uses an available supported MCP operation or ntn files create when that capability is missing. If the applicable CLI is absent, provides the official installation and authentication URLs and exact next step without auto-installing or exposing credentials.

evals.name: cli-required-headless-ci
evals.prompt: I need a daily Notion sync running from my GitHub Actions workflow — no interactive Claude session available there.
evals.expected_output: Uses the supported ntn CLI flow for the requested GitHub Actions script, with secrets stored in the CI secret store and supported non-interactive flags verified from CLI help. Does not claim MCP requires an interactive Claude session or put credentials in tracked files. No service activation or deployment beyond the request.

evals.name: skip-different-knowledge-tool
evals.prompt: Delete the Linear issue blocking my sprint and reassign the parent epic to me.
evals.expected_output: Skill does not trigger — Linear is a different knowledge tool and out of scope. The skip-condition in the description holds (request targets a different knowledge tool: Linear, Confluence, Coda, Obsidian). Defers to whatever Linear-specific tooling the session has, or asks the user how they want to proceed.

evals.name: batch-rows-over-loop
evals.prompt: Add these 80 task rows from my CSV to the Sprint database in Notion.
evals.expected_output: Fetches the Sprint data-source schema, maps all CSV columns without guessing and checks the active create-pages batch limit. Uses batching when the tools and user's authorization/readback constraints permit it; reports and verifies the actual resulting rows.

evals.name: codex-mcp-capability-routing
evals.prompt: I am using Codex with notion-fetch available. Read the current Engineering page and summarize its open decisions.
evals.expected_output: Uses the available Notion MCP in Codex, fetches the requested page and summarizes it without forcing ntn, requiring Claude or writing anything.
